task_refs.description: Create a test SoundWave, SoundClass, and SoundCue, assign class metadata, save, validate, and read references back
Create a SoundWave-backed SoundCue, delete the cue through the audio namespace, and verify the source wave remains while the cue is gone
Create attenuation, mix, concurrency, and submix assets, edit routing settings, save, and read each value back
Build a SoundCue graph from a declarative spec with two WavePlayers feeding a Mixer, save it, and validate references
Apply a batch audio template to a generated SoundWave, save it, and read back routing/compression/looping fields
Create a procedural SoundWave, batch-edit core SoundWave properties, save it, then read volume and pitch back
Create parent/child SoundClass assets and a SoundMix ducking adjuster, save them, then read hierarchy and mix timing back
Create root and child SoundSubmix assets, reparent the child and set output volume, save both, then read hierarchy back
Create two SoundWaves, build a weighted-random SoundCue template, save it, then inspect graph nodes and wave references
Create near/far SoundWaves, build a DistanceCrossFade SoundCue template, save it, then inspect crossfade bands and references
Create two synthetic SoundWave assets, build a layered mixer SoundCue with per-layer volumes, save it, and read the graph back
Create a looping ambient SoundCue with Looping, Delay, Random, WavePlayer nodes, save it, and read the graph back
Create a Switch SoundCue, duplicate it, save both assets, and verify the duplicated graph and wave references
Create two SoundWave assets, batch-assign shared class/attenuation/submix/looping settings, save both, and read back both routed assets
Create and edit a SoundConcurrency asset, batch-attach it to two SoundWaves, save all assets, and read the concurrency settings and registry entry back
Create two SoundWaves, batch-edit compression fields, batch-rename through the audio namespace, save renamed assets, and read compression plus registry names back
Create SoundWaves and an empty SoundCue, add/connect/set/remove graph nodes through primitive actions, save it, and validate the resulting graph
Create two SoundWaves, batch-enable looping and PlayWhenSilent virtualization, save both, and verify looping plus the native VirtualizationMode enum read-back
Create a SoundWave, bind Monolith perception user data, save it, and read back exact hearing/noise settings
Create a SoundWave, bind and then remove Monolith perception user data, save it, and verify the binding is absent
Create a MetaSound Source asset, author graph-level input/output pins, edit an input default, save it, and read the graph back
Create a MetaSound Source, add a graph variable with generated get/set nodes, save it, and inspect document variables
Create a SoundWave test tone, build a one-shot MetaSound Source around it, save both assets, and read back graph and asset metadata
Create a looping ambient MetaSound Source from a SoundWave, create a preset referencing it, save all assets, and read back graph and dependency metadata
Create a synthesized MetaSound Source with oscillator and ADSR parameters, save it, and read graph summary, user parameter, and validation state back
Create two deterministic SoundWaves, build a parameter-driven interactive MetaSound crossfade graph, save all assets, and read graph and validation state back
Create a MetaSound Patch asset, add graph-level input/output pins, save it, and verify patch metadata plus user parameters
Build a MetaSound Patch from a JSON spec, add a graph node by alias, edit its editor location, remove it, save, and verify the final graph
Create a MetaSound Source, add two graph nodes by alias, discover their pins, connect and disconnect the nodes by pin name, save it, and verify the final graph
